description:
Buys line time by the millisecond, $0.000001 each; buying again adds time. Returns your channelId, the time bought and the time left. Then open a line with the line tool. Time you do not burn comes back on refund.
Not idempotent: each call buys more time.
Paid. With no wallet code, pay with ZEAM :: Pass: a pass (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/pass) or your own wallet (https://mcp.zeamprism.com/how-to-pay).
Example: {"ms":60000}

ms.description: milliseconds of line time; default 250. Buying again adds time

name: buy_time

anyOf.description: time on the channel after this payment

title: Buy line time
